title: Before you start: simulation and education only
body: TradeLab is a learning app. It is not a broker, a signal service, or financial advice for your situation.
Everything you trade here is simulated or on a demo account. TradeLab never places real trades, never asks for broker logins, and never handles money.
Trading strategies can lose money. Past performance does not guarantee future results.
Scores and certificates in TradeLab measure learning and discipline. They are not licences and they do not show that you are likely to make money.
